decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

- 0437 87 102 � Proposed Window & Door Schedule
- 0437 87 101 � Proposed Elevations
- 0437 87 103 � Proposed Roof Plan
- PVC-U Window Systems � Casement windows � REHAU S706 70MM
- REHAU Heritage � Period System spec
- CW_Brochure_Whitelabelv3

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Front elevation windows: Double-glazed, timber-framed sliding sash windows, with run through sash horns (white finish), colour, style, detail and finish to match  the existing windows to be replaced.  

- Rear and side elevation windows: Double-glazed, timber-framed sliding sash windows, with run through sash horns (white finish) and double-glazed, REHAU heritage uPVC frames with glazing bars (white finish), all with colour, style, detail and finish to match the existing  windows to be replaced.  

- Front door: Double-glazed door to match existing.

- Rear door: uPVC door to match existing.

- Roof repairs: materials to match existing.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC6 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - Where the existing windows to be replaced are obscure glazed and/or fixed shut they shall be replaced with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3, and where relevant shall be non-opening and fixed shut up to a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level. The windows shall thereafter be permanently retained in this form.

To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Replacement of existing single glazed timber framed windows with new double glazed timber framed windows to the front elevation; replacement of existing single glazed timber framed windows with new double glazed timber framed windows and double glazed uPVC framed windows to the rear elevation, replacement of existing single glazed timber framed windows with new double glazed uPVC framed windows to the side of rear back additions; replacement of existing doors to front and rear elevations; repair works at roof level comprising of new tiles, replacement of ridges and re-bed tiles, re-bed chimney pot, new replacement roof covering and chimney parapets, and repoint both sides parapets.
